winDialogue: Do you want to be my friend?
loseDialogue: Hum…I don't want you as my friend.

winDialogue: I don't like anything ugly.
loseDialogue: You lost, so ugly!

winDialogue: Let us be friends?
loseDialogue: Hahaha…

winDialogue: Let me protect you.
loseDialogue: You are more powerful than me.

winDialogue: Trust your partners.
loseDialogue: The previous one doesn't count.

winDialogue: Do you want ice cream?
loseDialogue: I ate too much ice cream.

winDialogue: Crossing blades, that's my focus!
loseDialogue: Let's become stronger together!

winDialogue: I want to beat Byakuya
loseDialogue: I am really a tramp down to my bones. I hate myself. I bark at the moon, but I don't have the courage to jump and grab it.

winDialogue: The more you try an' hide something away, the more people want to see it!
loseDialogue: I don't want to see it, I'm just curious.

winDialogue: In a battle, the ones who get in the way are not the ones that lack power, but the ones that lack resolve.
loseDialogue: Even if the heart is shaken, the blade will never be shaken.

winDialogue: When you have someone you want to protect, you'll become powerful.
loseDialogue: Being young means that you're still naive.

winDialogue: It's too soon to get too cocky
loseDialogue: Everything in this world will try to kill you.

winDialogue: I have not thrown my life away. I have merely gambled it.
loseDialogue: I am just as you say...a mere worm of a man

winDialogue: Are you sad? You should be happy that you are alive.
loseDialogue: If you want to teach someone a lesson, you got to be tough.

winDialogue: No world is without sacrifices. But if we produce casualties, we would also sustain casualties of our own.
loseDialogue: You stood no chance. With the bite of a shark, a dragon of ice shall sink beneath the waves.

winDialogue: Did you see Byakuya?
loseDialogue: I'm going to go look for Byakuya?

winDialogue: Puh-Lease! I'm just a lowly-but-handsome merchant. How could I possibly perform Bankai?
loseDialogue: A warrior who has lost his strength will only get in the way.

winDialogue: Do you want to be a man and beaten by me?
loseDialogue: 'To announce your name and rank' is a custom taught to us when we learn how to fight. It's known as the last courtesy. If a person dies in combat, at least you get to know the name of the one that brought death to you.

winDialogue: Justice without a great cause begets nothing more than slaughter. However, that same slaughter in the name of a great cause is justice
loseDialogue: My eyes can only see one path and that is the path with the least amount of bloodshed. Justice, is always there, and the path I follow, is justice.

winDialogue: Waiting patiently and believing in your subordinates is all part of a captain's job.
loseDialogue: Don't waste your time trying to play the good guy. No matter what debts you may owe, from the instant you find yourself on the battleground, both sides are evil.

winDialogue: Friends are a good thing, even if they tread a different path.
loseDialogue: To sink all the way to the level of allying with the Menos. What are you trying to do?

winDialogue: With your ability, you will find it impossible to make me fall on even one knee.
loseDialogue: Sakura does not love the branches, as warriors do not love life!

winDialogue: "This Reiatsu... Even though I don't know who it's from, they seem to be deep in the heat of battle. Not bad. It sure makes your blood boil, doesn't it?"
loseDialogue: "It's been so long that I forgot the pain of not having a name. Everyone had a name that friends use to call them, but I didn't. That pain."

winDialogue: There is not a single person in heaven or on earth that can break me. Don't forget that I am the strongest Espada.
loseDialogue: I don't do "mercy". Strong, weak, infant, monster. I just smash 'em all to pieces. I don't give 'em the chance to get up a second time.

winDialogue: The act of saving a comrade in need should require no thanks.
loseDialogue: Treacherous reprobate!

winDialogue: Arrogante!
loseDialogue: Aizen, I'm going to kill you!

winDialogue: I'm a snake. Cold of flesh and devoid of heart. My tongue flicks back and forth, ever in search of new prey, and if I like what I find, I swallow 'em whole.
loseDialogue: It would have been nice if my capture lasted a little longer.

winDialogue: I have no interest in whether it is right or wrong. All I care about is executing orders as a captain of the Gotei 13.
loseDialogue: Why... Why... Why didn't you take me with you?

winDialogue: "I'm not alone. I'm not alone. I'm not alone any more..."
loseDialogue: I so envied the weak. The weak can always find others to be around.

winDialogue: Nothing can change my world!
loseDialogue: No matter dead or alive, everyone is lonely…

winDialogue: What a weakling!
loseDialogue: Don't force me to say bad things about you.

winDialogue: The unbearable vacancy of the throne in the sky is over. From now on...I will be sitting on it
loseDialogue: Vision is the farthest distance from the understanding!
